claim: On the two frozen standing-recall evaluations, a strong property-aware MemoRepair-style baseline matched OpenLine on scored correctness; OpenLine's surviving distinction was a smaller repair/replay surface.
claim_boundary: DGRR and MemoRepair comparisons are contract abstractions, not author implementations.
SRE-001 lifecycle events are controlled adaptations, not natural revocations.
SRE-002 uses only eight retrospectively represented public events and is not prospective, blinded, random, or representative of event frequency.
These results do not establish dependency discovery, truth inference, rollback of irreversible external effects, broad generality, or a production API promotion.
The stable 0.5.2 Evidence Recall release claim remains unchanged.

experiments.substrate: 5 pinned LongMemEval-V2 trajectory excerpts, 10 state anchors, 40 controlled lifecycle episodes
